Last Will and Testament 1848 January Mutilated Document

In the Name of God, Amen this fifth day of January in the year of Our Lord one Thousand Eight Hundred & forty eight. I Gillico A. Hansor of Dover Hundred County of Kent and Stat of Deliware being verry weak in Boddy but of Sound and disposeinge mind and memory and calling to mind the mortality of my Body and knowing that it is apointed fore all men once to Die Do make and order this This my Last will and Testament in the manner and form follinge that is to Say I Recomend my Body to Earth to be buried in Christen Lik manner and commit my Sole To the keepping all mighty God My will is that all my Just Debts and funeal Expence to be paid and Discharge and Then I give and bequeath to An Carney A Wife William Carney Decest(?) {all my moveable estate} during Her naturel Life and no longer (unclear). Then I give and bequeath to Sally A. Cambridge A girle I (unclear) forever in witness here of I have here unto set my hand Seat this fifth Day of January one thousand Eight hundred forty Eight and Sealed in the presense of Elisha Durham (signed), James Carney (his mark) and George Hall (signed) Gilico A. Hansor (her mark)
